DefaultFrequency.Name: Default Frequency
DefaultFrequency.Hint: The Frequency a sound gets when it's first switched to Randomize. Sounds that already have a Frequency keep theirs.

Hint.min: Seconds of silence, at least, between plays at this Frequency (1 to 600).
Hint.max: Seconds of silence, at most, between plays at this Frequency (1 to 600). If it's below the shortest gap, the two swap.
